title: pyrus alabaster
intro: Pyrus alabaster, commonly known as white pear or mountain ash, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree that has been used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus alabaster include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
